scheme_name: North East Special Infrastructure Development Scheme (NESIDS)
overview: The North East Special Infrastructure Development Scheme (NESIDS), launched in 2017, provides full central funding to North Eastern States for vital infrastructure in water, power, connectivity, tourism, education, and health. Roads projects are handled by the North Eastern Council (NEC), while other infrastructure falls under the Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER). The scheme aims to accelerate socio-economic development in the North Eastern Region by addressing critical infrastructure gaps.
objectives: Provide full central funding for vital infrastructure in water, power, connectivity, tourism, education, and health
Handle roads projects through the North Eastern Council (NEC)
Manage other infrastructure projects through the Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER)
Accelerate sustainable development in the North-East through infrastructure and social projects
Bridge sectoral gaps in the North Eastern Region
Ensure growth parity with the rest of the country
Strengthen institutions and networks for livelihood and social services
eligibility: North Eastern States are eligible for funding under NESIDS for infrastructure projects in water, power, connectivity, tourism, education, and health sectors. Roads projects are implemented by NEC, while other infrastructure projects are implemented by MDoNER.
benefits: Full central funding for infrastructure projects, implementation support through NEC for roads and MDoNER for other infrastructure, focus on vital sectors including water, power, connectivity, tourism, education, and health, and contribution to socio-economic development and growth parity with the rest of India.
financial_support: NESIDS offers full central funding (100% Government of India funding) for approved infrastructure projects in the North Eastern States. The financial support is provided as grants for creation of capital assets, with specific budget allocations detailed in the Detailed Demands for Grants documents.
application_process: The evidence does not provide a specific step-by-step application process for NESIDS. Proposals are likely submitted through state governments to the respective implementing agencies (NEC for roads, MDoNER for other infrastructure) as part of the annual budget planning process.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER) and North Eastern Council (NEC)
caveats: Roads projects are handled by NEC, while other infrastructure falls under MDoNER
The scheme is a Central Sector Scheme with 100% funding by the Government of India
Funding is subject to annual budget allocations and approval processes
